capabilities: , Change text case (UPPERCASE, lowercase, Sentence case, Capitalize Each Word)
Apply changes via editor context menu
Support multiple selections and accented letters
problem: Users require a simple way to apply standard text casing rules, similar to those found in word processors, to selected text within Obsidian.
summary: A text case formatter that allows users to change selected text to uppercase, lowercase, sentence case, or capitalize each word via commands, hotkeys, and the context menu.
